article.title: The Gaza genocide permanently diminished the power of pro-Israel propaganda
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Since October 7 and the Gaza genocide, U.S. opinions on Israel and Palestine have drastically shifted. The power of Zionist propaganda has been permanently weakened, and the U.S.-Israel relationship is in a more precarious position than ever before.
